model: NAH-1 — N/A on a hyperimaginary axis (high but imprecise)

design.na_is_imprecise: wide spread on real (under-determined) AND on high j
design.fair_baseline: blind classifier keeps an N/A prototype; it just lacks the j-axis, so it sees N/A's NATURAL C4 projection = origin (NOT a hand-set fold onto MI); N/A competes fairly and loses recall only because the plane can't separate an off-plane imprecise point from the other labels' tails.

verdict.consistent_with_PDR1_direction: NA-holding > NA-blind (B108 direction); the numeric band-match is NOT treated as independent evidence

honesty.claim: representational CAPACITY: the hyperimaginary geometry CAN hold the N/A vs base-4 distinction the C4 plane cannot; robust over seeds
honesty.falsifier_NAH1_F1: OPEN — a genuinely 4-valued (non-N/A) corpus must NOT need the j-axis; if every real labelling task is fit equally well WITHOUT j, j is ornamental, not a joint.
